items.title: Spring Bonnie (Film)
items.summary: Spring Bonnie is an old, mechanical, Springlock suit worn by William Afton in the 2023 film Five Nights at Freddy's and returns via flashbacks in the 2025 sequel Five Nights at Freddy's 2.

items.title: Glamrock Bonnie
items.summary: Glamrock Bonnie, also known as just Bonnie, was a glamrock counterpart of Bonnie who was mentioned in Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach and made an official appearance in the RUIN DLC.

items.title: Henry Emily (Film)
items.summary: Henry Emily is a major character in the 2025 film Five Nights at Freddy's 2.  He is the former business partner of William Afton and the father of the late Charlotte Emily.
